subject: Urgent: BlueHorizon latency spike + errors — KV cache review & mitigation
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@bluehorizonlabs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Clark <devon.clark@bluehorizonlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Severe latency + 5xxs impacting production — urgent help needed

Evelyn,

We started seeing a sharp increase in generation latency this morning (p95 ~2.6s -> 9.8s, p99 spiking above 18s) and a 4% 5xx rate on several customer-facing routes. Throughput has dropped ~30% versus the usual baseline. This is impacting active users and our support queue is filling up.

We haven't changed any traffic patterns on our side; snapshot attached (profiler_snapshot.tar.gz). Can you confirm whether this aligns with anything on your end? The logs show repeated KV cache misses/evictions and some long queuing for batch lanes.

We need a triage call within the hour. Dev and procurement are CC'd.

— Sofia
Head of ML Engineering, BlueHorizon Labs

Attachment: profiler_snapshot.tar.gz (log bundle)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@bluehorizonlabs.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Clark <devon.clark@bluehorizonlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xxs impacting production — urgent help needed

Sofia — thank you for the alert and for the snapshot. I'm jumping on this with the infra on-call now. Can you confirm the affected routes and an example request id from the logs? I'll get us a 30-minute triage standup and invite the right engineers.

I'll escalate to Evelyn and Monica if we see KV-level interference.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@bluehorizonlabs.com>, Devon Clark <devon.clark@bluehorizonlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xxs impacting production — urgent help needed

Ben / team — I pulled the profiler bundle. Quick summary:
- Multiple long tail traces show HOL (head-of-line) blocking in the KV cache lookup path when large prefixes are present.
- Continuous small write bursts are causing prefetched prefixes to be evicted, leading to cache thrash.
- Batch lane queueing observed: while total tokens/sec dropped, individual lane latency increased due to batch formation delays and hotspots.

Immediate mitigations I'm going to propose for the triage call:
1) Temporarily reduce prefix prefetch aggressiveness for BlueHorizon to avoid eviction storms (config patch attached).
2) Enable soft-rate-limit on low-priority batch lanes to free up hot lane capacity.
3) Short-term canary to a slightly quantized variant to reduce memory pressure if needed.

Attaching a config diff: redwood-config-diff.patch

I'll be on the triage call in 5.

— Monica Patel
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-config-diff.patch
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@bluehorizonlabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Clark <devon.clark@bluehorizonlabs.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xxs impacting production — urgent help needed

Thanks Monica — that matches what we see. Example request id: req_20290712_BH_91e4. The affected routes are:
- /api/v1/generate-chat (primary)
- /api/v1/embedding (secondary)

Please proceed with the config changes. We'll stand by for any fallback/rollbacks and a short postmortem. Also, please put a temporary SLA credit hold — our CS team needs to communicate to customers.

— Sofia
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec sync: BlueHorizon impact — proposed customer remediation and executive note

Team — I reviewed the incident notes and customer impact. BlueHorizon is a strategic mid-market account with potential expansion this quarter. They reported sustained p99s above 15s and transactional failures that required user retries.

Proposed actions for executive visibility and to stabilize renewals: 
- Approve an immediate 15% credit for July impacted usage.
- Assign an SRE taskforce (Monica lead) to run a 48-hour observation with the reduced prefetch profile and soft-rate-limiting applied.
- Prepare a one-pager for BlueHorizon summarizing root cause (KV eviction thrash + HOL blocking) and next steps within 24 hours.

Monica — confirm that the config changes are safe for an extended observation window and estimate rollback risk. Ben — coordinate the credit paperwork and notify procurement. Evelyn — please be copied on the customer-facing note.

— Jonas Weber
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@bluehorizonlabs.com>, Devon Clark <devon.clark@bluehorizonlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: BlueHorizon latency spike + errors — KV cache review & mitigation

Sofia / Devon — thank you again for the detailed logs and patience. Quick summary of what we did and what you can expect: 

What we changed (already live):
- Reduced prefix prefetch aggressiveness for your tenant to minimize eviction storms.
- Enabled soft-rate-limits on lower-priority batch lanes to reduce HOL blocking when big prefixes are evicted.
- Turned on a temporary memory-conservative kernel selection (slight quantize) for susceptible model variants while we monitor.

Immediate results we observed in our canary: p95 down from 9.8s -> 3.1s within 30 minutes; p99s trending under 9s; 5xxs reduced from ~4% to 0.6%. Throughput recovered to ~92% baseline after the change, with tail improving as the cache warmed.

Next steps:
- Monica will run a 48-hour observation window and produce a short postmortem (root cause: mix of prefetch policy + write bursts -> eviction thrash causing HOL blocking).
- Ben will coordinate a 15% credit for impacted July usage and send procurement a formal doc.
- We'll follow up with a one-page RCA and a recommended long-term fix: adaptive prefetch that detects eviction storms and backoffs automatically, plus a cache-aware batching policy.

We appreciate the call earlier and will keep this thread updated. If you prefer a joint executive summary, I'm happy to hop on a short call with your leadership to walk through results.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: postmortem-draft-v1.md (will be shared to Drive)
